title: Show HN: Hallucinopedia
summary: Hallucinopedia is an encyclopedia-style resource documenting common hallucinations (false outputs) produced by AI and LLM models, serving as a reference tool to help users understand and identify when AI systems generate incorrect or fabricated information.
problem_solved: Addresses the widespread problem of AI hallucinations by creating a centralized, searchable knowledge base documenting known false outputs from AI systems.
why_valuable: It provides AI users and developers with a practical reference to verify AI outputs and better understand the limitations of current language models, ultimately improving AI literacy and reducing misinformation.
